caption: The drawing depicts a glass bottle shown from three perspectives: front, side, and a larger, more detailed front view at the bottom center. The bottle is flask-shaped with a flat base, curved shoulders, and a short cylindrical neck. Its surface is depicted in shades of light blue-green, giving the appearance of transparent or lightly tinted glass. The front of the bottle features a raised profile portrait of a human figure facing to the right, with long hair and classical facial features. Around the portrait are embossed capital letters reading "BRIDGETOWN NEW JERSEY." The body of the bottle shows vertical ridges running down its sides. The side view in the upper right corner emphasizes the bottle's flatness and the ribbed texture. The artist's name “FRANCIS LAW DURAND” is written in the lower right corner of the drawing. The paper background is a light beige or off-white color.
title: Bottle
